capabilities: Create tasting notes with wine, whisky, and general tasting fields
Rate bottles and sort the sidebar by rating
Mark notes as in-cellar with quantity and purchase date
Browse tasting notes in an All/Wine/Whisky sidebar
Configure the folder where tasting notes are stored
extras: The manifest carries an unreiewed-by-Obsidian-staff notice; usage instructions are limited to searching commands in the command palette.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record drink-specific tasting details like nose, palate, distillery, ABV, or cellar inventory in a consistent format.
summary: Structured tasting-note logger for wine, whisky, and beer with domain fields, ratings, cellar tracking, and a sorting sidebar.
